title: Unified rollouts: enhance canary/A-B/shadow autorollback workflow, observability, and safety guards
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: customers running large-scale canary and shadow rollouts need more deterministic autorollback behavior and better observability to diagnose regressions. This PR improves the autorollback workflow by tightening metric windows, adding quorum semantics for multi-metric decisions, and surfacing rollout decision signals to the Console. It also adds safety guards (quarantine stage) and telemetry to detect flaky signal sources. Summary of changes: 1) Autorollback engine: add 'quorum' mode to require N of M metric breaches before initiating rollback, configurable per-rollout; add exponential backoff for rapid oscillation avoidance; expose decision rationale in trace logs. 2) Metric windows: switch from fixed sliding windows to adaptive windows based on recent latency/throughput variance to reduce false positives on bursty workloads. 3) Shadow & canary integration: ensure shadow traffic metrics are isolated and labeled so probe metrics do not bleed into canary decisions; add an optional preflight probing stage that can quarantine a variant before promoting to canary. 4) Observability: new Console dashboard panel (autorollback-overview) that shows per-rollout metric stream, decision timeline, and sampled traces; add rollout decision events to existing trace/span model. 5) Tests & e2e: add deterministic unit tests for quorum logic, simulation harness for oscillation scenarios, and several e2e scenarios that run on the canary-emulator. 6) Docs: update unified-rollouts.md with config examples and migration notes. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked: Linear ENG-4123 - [x] Unit tests added for quorum and backoff - [x] Integration/e2e tests for canary/shadow flows - [x] Console panels implemented and wired to telemetry - [x] Perf bench within acceptable bounds (regression <2% p50) Backwards compatibility: default behavior preserves existing single-metric threshold flow unless 'quorum' or 'adaptive_window' are enabled in rollout spec. Migration: customers who rely on precise window sizes should opt-in to 'adaptive_window' and validate on staging. Risks & mitigations: - Oscillation: mitigated with exponential backoff and a minimum cool-down between decisions. - Noisy shadow probes: mitigated by isolating probe metrics and an optional quarantine stage. Testing & rollout plan: run canary for 72h on staging with the 'quorum' set to 2-of-3 for safety; enable observability retention for rollout traces for 7 days; coordinate with platform on Dedicated rollout. Follow-ups: add UI for editing quorum thresholds per-rollout (tracked in ENG-4187); expand simulation harness for multi-region routing effects.
